title: Recursive majority tree query count
statement: Let $d$ be a nonnegative integer, let $o\\in\\{0,1,2\\}$, choose three seeds for depth $d$, and let $x$ be a sign assignment on $3^{d+1}$ coordinates. The query count of the depth-$d+1$ recursive majority tree is given by the following rule: if $o=0$, it is the query count of the first depth-$d$ tree on block $0$, plus that of the second on block $1$, plus zero when the recursive majority values on blocks $0$ and $1$ agree and otherwise the query count of the third tree on block $2$. If $o=1$, use blocks $0$ and $2$ first and, only when their recursive majority values differ, add the query count of the second seed's tree on block $1$. If $o=2$, use blocks $1$ and $2$ first and, only when their recursive majority values differ, add the query count of the first seed's tree on block $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Three depth-d recursive majority seeds are given
